sloka: किं नु खल्वद्य गम्भीरो मूर्च्छितो न निशम्यते ।यथापुरमयोध्यायां गीतवादित्रनिस्वन: ॥ २.११४.२२॥
transliteration: kiṁ nu khalvadya gambhīro mūrcchito na niśamyate ।yathāpuramayodhyāyāṁ gītavāditranisvana: ॥ 2.114.22॥

translations.english: How is it that in Ayodhya, the deep and allpervasive songs and sounds of musical instruments of the former days are not heard now?
